description: Use this when the user wants to see what the AI drafter draws, or examples of AI-made CAD floor plans. Lists published drawings from the Plan Chat CAD studio (real, unretouched output), each with a preview, the brief it was drawn from, a free DXF download and a link to draw a similar one.

query.description: Optional words to filter by, e.g. "townhouse", "office", "3 bedrooms".
